_doc: The surface registry. A LEDGER is the rule file of one kind of artifact; a SURFACE is where a sentence of feedback is typed. Adding a loop = one entry under ledgers (and a skill-map-<key>.json), plus one line under surface_ledger for every new place a sentence can come from. See docs/01-rule-loop.md, 'The template of a loop'.

email.about: how a message to a person is written (any channel)

hub.about: whether an approval card should exist, and what a card must show

crm.about: a CRM row, a next step, who someone is, a contact route, follow-up timing

notif.about: what reaches the owner's phone unasked (notification cards, recaps, done-notifications)
